title: The microbiologist leak: experts judge the author doctorate-level

tellings.quote: lot of that stuff. Uh, they seem to think that this person is definitely like doctorate level microbiology.

plain: In 2023 an anonymous person claiming to be a microbiologist posted a document online, now called the microbiologist leak, and people who know the field supposedly judged that the author is "definitely like doctorate level microbiology." Chris Ramsay, a guest who researches the subject, tells Michels this without naming the experts. The point is that the leak's writer seems to know the science, which would make it harder to wave away.
